ctx: Film 「Red One」(2024, Amazon MGM, director Jake Kasdan). Dwayne Johnson as Callum Drift, commander of E.L.F. (North Pole security) and Santa's bodyguard, about to retire; Chris Evans as Jack O'Malley, a cynical hacker and bounty hunter on the naughty list who unknowingly sells the North Pole's location; J.K. Simmons as Santa Claus (code name Red One), who is kidnapped on Christmas Eve; Lucy Liu as Zoe Harlow, director of M.O.R.A.; Kiernan Shipka as Gryla, a winter witch who wants to imprison everyone on the naughty list in snow globes; Kristofer Hivju as Krampus, Santa's estranged brother; Bonnie Hunt as Mrs. Claus; Wesley Kimmel as Dylan, Jack's son; Nick Kroll as Ned Coleman.
